description: This header defines utilities for testing HTTP transactions within the Chromium project, including mock transaction data, mock network layer and transaction classes, and test consumers for HTTP transactions.

classes.name: MockTransaction
classes.description: Struct representing a mock HTTP transaction with configurable parameters for testing.

classes.name: MockHttpRequest
classes.description: Class representing a mock HTTP request based on a MockTransaction.

classes.name: TestTransactionConsumer
classes.description: Class to test complete consumption of an HTTP transaction.

classes.name: MockNetworkTransaction
classes.description: Class simulating a network transaction, supporting synchronous and asynchronous operations for testing.

classes.name: MockNetworkLayer
classes.description: Class simulating a network layer that creates mock network transactions.

classes.name: ConnectedHandler
classes.description: Helper class for injecting connected callbacks into HTTP transactions.

methods.name: DefaultTransportInfo
methods.description: Returns default transport info for mock transactions.

methods.name: FindMockTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a mock transaction for a given URL.

methods.name: AddMockTransaction
methods.description: Adds a mock transaction to the internal registry.

methods.name: RemoveMockTransaction
methods.description: Removes a mock transaction from the internal registry.

methods.name: ReadTransaction
methods.description: Reads the entire transaction data into a string.
